note: Hand-written half of knowledge/zform.json: the .zform document schema exactly as stdlib/System/Compiler/GenForm.zan reads it. The controls/ half is generated from the stdlib sources by scripts/gen_zform.ps1; tests/run_zform_schema.cmake fails if a key here stops existing in GenForm.zan or GenForm.zan starts reading a key that is not documented here.
pipeline: .zform (JSON) --zanc formgen--> partial class projection (no file on disk to edit) --> compiled together with the hand-written code-behind (src/App.zan, static void OnLoad(Form form)). Never edit generated layout code; edit the .zform.

keys.doc: Class name of the projected partial class; must be a valid Zan identifier or it falls back to the file's base name.

"control" projects an embeddable `partial class X : Control` (panel/view/card) whose named children are instance fields; a control document cannot be the project entry. Default/"window" projects a window whose named children are static fields.
Window caption.
Logical window width; values <= 0 are ignored.
Logical window height; values <= 0 are ignored.
Center the window on the work area instead of using winPosX/winPosY.
Window left, used when winCenter is false.
Window top, used when winCenter is false.
Allow the user to resize the window.
Draw the standard title bar / frame; false gives a chromeless window.
Window opacity in percent; 0 means opaque (no per-window alpha).
Blur-behind (acrylic) window background.

Silhouette. As an int: 0 = rectangular window, 1 = rounded rect (radius from winShapeRadius), 2 = ellipse filling the window box. As an array it is a region list, each region {t,x,y,w,h,r} in logical px with t: 1 = rect, 2 = ellipse, 3 = shadow band; regions with w<=0 or h<=0 are dropped.
Corner radius for winShape = 1.
Designer's "round window" switch; same silhouette as winShape = 2.
Drop-shadow spread in logical px; prepends a type-3 shadow band to the silhouette (clamped to 8..64 including the largest corner radius). Only applies when the window has a silhouette.
0 = flow: fields are docked top-to-bottom inside an FbFlow grid and each field takes `span` of 24 columns. 1 = free: every field is positioned with fx/fy/fw/fh and `dock`.
Control tree; each element is a field object (see fields.keys). Containers nest through "kids".

fields.note: One object per control in "fields" / "kids". Every key is optional except "kind".

keys.doc: The Zan *class name* of the control, e.g. "Button", "Panel", "SelectBox", "CefBrowserBox". The projection emits `new <kind>()`, so any Control class the compiler can resolve is legal - not just the designer palette. Note this is the class name, not Control.Kind() (SelectBox's Kind() is "Select"). Compile error if it is not a valid identifier.

Type arguments for a generic control: "kind": "ListView", "of": "string" projects ListView<string>; comma-separate multiple arguments. Every argument must be a Zan type name (dotted names allowed). ListView/Dropdown/DataGrid default to "string" when "of" is absent.

Field name for the projected control. A valid, unique identifier becomes a typed field (OkButton, TitleLabel, ...) reachable from the code-behind; otherwise the control stays anonymous. Also assigned to control.name.
Design-time caption: projected as SetDesignText(...), which controls that publish a text property (Label/Button/Checkbox/...) use as their content; containers ignore it.
CSS class(es) for the control (skin / size variants), projected as control.Class.
Pass-through table of the control's own properties, projected as SetProp(key, value) - keys are the control's PropSpec keys (see controls[] in this file), values are strings.
String choices for choice controls; joined with '|' and projected as SetProp("options", ...).
Projected as SetProp("placeholder", ...).
Projected as SetProp("required", "true") and included in the generated validation pass.
Default-on switch/checkbox; projected as SetProp("defOn", "true").
Two-way binding path into the state entity, projected as control.bindPath; the host syncs both sides around each frame.
Property written by "bind"; defaults to the control's value property. Ignored without "bind".
Child field objects. A field with a "kids" array is treated as a container (padding/gap apply, children are projected into it).

Slot index inside the parent container (tab page, split pane); children are added to parent.SlotHost(index) instead of the container itself. Without it, children of a multi-slot container all overlap.
Flow layout only (layoutMode 0): width of the field in a 24-column grid, clamped to 1..24.
Free layout only (layoutMode 1, dock 0): logical x.
Free layout only (layoutMode 1, dock 0): logical y.
Preferred logical width. Omit it on a docked control to have the control measure itself; for dock 0 (absolute) it is the box width. Also used as the fixed extent for dock Left/Right.
Preferred logical height (32 in flow layout when absent). Also used as the fixed extent for dock Top/Bottom.
Free layout only (layoutMode 1).
Container inner padding in logical px (free layout, containers only). Absent means the style sheet decides.
Container child spacing in logical px (free layout, containers only). Absent means the style sheet decides.

Handler binding: any key starting with "on" binds the event named after the prefix to the handler named by the value, e.g. "onClick": "Save" binds Click to the code-behind's Save handler. Legal event names are the control's Events() (see controls[].events).

DataGrid only: declarative typed columns (see columns.keys). Requires "of" naming the row entity type; each column projects a typed accessor lambda (`__r => __r.<field>`) onto the generic column API (Col/NumCol/RealCol/BoolCol/DateCol), so a wrong field name or type is a compile error on the generated code. Rows stay the caller's List<of> - bind data from the code-behind with grid.Bind(list); no DataRow / string-row conversion is involved.
DataGrid only: project RowFactory(() => new <of>()) so the add-row placeholder (allowAddRow) can append new entity rows. Requires "of".

columns.note: One object per DataGrid column in a field's "columns" array. Only "field" is required.

keys.doc: Field name on the row entity (the "of" type); becomes the typed accessor `__r => __r.<field>` and the engine-side stable column name (.Field). Must be an identifier (dotted paths allowed).
Header caption.
Column width in logical px.
Column value type; selects the generic column API (Col/NumCol/RealCol/BoolCol/DateCol) and therefore the accessor's expected field type (string/int/double/bool/string).
type "real" only: decimal places.
type "date" only: DateCol sort-order code.
Cell alignment (numeric columns already right-align by default).
Currency symbol; projects .Money(symbol).
Render as percentage; projects .Percent().
Literal text before the value; with "suffix" projects .Affix(prefix, suffix).
Literal text after the value.
Summary-row aggregate: total.
Summary-row aggregate: average.
Summary-row aggregate: minimum.
Summary-row aggregate: maximum.
Summary-row aggregate: row count.
Freeze the column at the given edge; projects .Pin() / .PinRight().
Header band (group) path; projects .Band(path).
false projects .NotSortable().
false projects .NotResizable().
Group rows by this column initially; projects .Grouped().
In-cell editing; projects .Editable((__r, __v) => ...) writing the parsed value back to the entity field by column type.
